preconditions: Exact application and image pins validated against the earlier qualification.
Owned disposable verified-TLS database, signed OPA, and the already loaded authenticated model.

normal_steps.action: Exercise declared workstation admission and separate actor custody.
normal_steps.expected: Ten active sessions, two durable occupied slots, and eight queued tasks. Receiver, training and replay ownership remain distinct.
normal_steps.actual: Reached the peak with scoped reads and fresh Help. The receiver and training scopes and the idempotent offline replay passed.

adverse_steps.action: Stop the model bridge, policy, canonical audit and Identity in turn, then pause the main role listeners together.
adverse_steps.expected: Matching narrow continuation when dependencies survive. No durable protected command for denied requests.
adverse_steps.actual: The model bridge fault left compute unknown and a human reply visible. Four other protected commands left no durable successful operation. Help and signed Static followed live authority availability.

adverse_steps.action: Stop an isolated Kubernetes deployment and probe the deployed authority and host boundaries.
adverse_steps.expected: Current workload and network denial evidence, separate host fallback survival and measured recovery.

checks.name: combined-loopback-outages
checks.expected: Observe current scoped behavior at declared load and across independent role faults.
checks.actual: The loopback topology reached 10 sessions, two occupied slots, and eight queued tasks. Five fault checks passed with real OPA, PostgreSQL and Qwen under synthetic test credentials.

checks.name: serialized-source-regression
checks.expected: Locked candidate source checks pass on the disposable TLS database.
checks.actual: 39 commands passed. Backend had 1778 passes and 4 skips.

checks.name: frozen-imp-planning-validator
checks.actual: Planning artifact drift in README.md matches the earlier baseline failure.

checks.name: deployed-kubernetes-and-host-continuity
checks.expected: Observe actual cluster outage, current deployed mTLS and CNI behavior, and separate host fallback.
checks.actual: This workstation has no configured Kubernetes context or cached disposable node image. The combined application run used owned TLS listeners.

checks.name: declared-load-deployed-cold-warm-error-distributions
checks.expected: Measure repeated deployed cold, warm and error timing at ten sessions.
checks.actual: This run measured a loaded model under loopback saturation and controlled failures. The cold follow-up measured one unloaded-model lifecycle separately.

residuals: Run an actual outage in the isolated Kubernetes topology, with current mTLS and CNI denial probes and separate host Help and Static process evidence.
Measure cold, warm, and error timing distributions at the declared ten-session load in the deployed topology.
Resolve the earlier frozen IMP planning README digest drift through the planning baseline workflow.
acceptance_scope: Synthetic loopback application outage behavior with exact local application and model pins. G-10 deployment qualification remains open.
rollback: Retain the exact restored local model and current authority settings. No service deployment or release was performed.
